    pid_b = pid // blocks_per_batch
    pid_m = (pid % blocks_per_batch) // num_pid_n
    pid_n = pid % num_pid_n

    b_base = b_ptr + pid_b * sb_b
    c_base = c_ptr + pid_b * sc_b
